controls.statement: Members of the Management body of the Financial entity must keep up to date with knowledge and skills to understand and assess ICT risk and its impact on the operations of the Financial entity, including regular training commensurate with the ICT risk being managed.

cite.quote: Members of the management body of the financial entity shall actively keep up to date with sufficient knowledge and skills to understand and assess ICT risk

evidence.description: Annual note that training or briefing was completed
Periodic management-body attestation (frequency from firm policy)

assurance_probes: Error: board members without ICT risk training
controls.notes: Generate evidence plumbing if needed; do not fake competence checks.
